title: 5.9.1. Risk Situations
content:
a. Discussions or agreements with competitors regarding prices, sales terms or conditions, costs, profits or profit margins, offer of services, division of territory, among others.

b. Any contact that may create an appearance of improper agreements or understandings, regardless if the contact has being made personally, in writing, by phone, email, or any other means of communication.
